usage: Secrets used in workflows should not be echoed in the console
name: Secrets used in workflows should not be echoed in the console
description: A secret may be echoed to a file for viewing forgotten secrets or for debugging purposes. This exposes the secret in the CI/CD output panel, and the secret may then be viewed by anyone with access to the output.
detailedDescription: A secret may be echoed to a file for viewing forgotten secrets or debugging purposes. This exposes the secret in the CI/CD output panel, and the secret may be revealed. For publicly viewable logs, the secret is now visible to everyone.
notes: This policy currently only applies to GitHub.

args.name: RepoType
args.label: Repo Visibility
args.tooltip: Determine if this policy applies to public repos, private repos or both.
